lines.en: Hey, uh, Rach, funny story.
I bumped into Joanna on the street yesterday.
My boss, Joanna?
Wow, that must have been awkward.
Well, no, actually, she, uh, asked me if I wanted to get a drink.
Ha!
You, uh, didn't say yes to that, did you?
Uh, no.
No.
Hello, Rachel.
Well, not at first.
What is she doing here?
Eh, eh, eh, eh.
I don't understand. Last time you went out with her, you said she was a big, dull dud.
Well, I think I judged her too quickly.
And this time, we were able to take the relationship to the next level.
Eh, eh, eh, eh.
Well, last time, I almost got fired.
You must end it. You must end it now.
Oh, come on. It's not like this is an everyday occurrence for me.
I mean, usually, I'm pretty much just in there by myself.
Eh, eh, eh.
